thread:
Priya (support): Ava from Acme reports intermittent 502s and a few 504s when calling our hosted generate endpoint during their long lived streaming requests. She says it started ~2024-06-05 11:37 UTC. Trace ids: trace-0a1b2c and trace-0d2e3f.
Mike (eng-sre): Thanks — are the errors concentrated around the model swap window or continuous?
Priya (support): Mostly during what looks like a model swap / rollout window, but some 502s outside of swaps too. Client saw a spike in upstream resets.
Oncall Bot: Deploy 1764242000 completed to hosted-api-rs-prod at 2024-06-05T11:35:20Z.
Jonah (infra): I pulled the edge logs for those traces, seeing lots of this pattern from Envoy: 
```
[envoy][error] upstream reset: RESET_REASON_TRANSPORT_FAILURE, details: TLS handshake timed out with upstream 10.2.34.56:443
```
Jonah (infra): Also saw repeated 503/502 responses from upstream NLB marked unhealthy for ~40s then recovered.
Mike (eng-sre): Can we get a curl repro from the customer showing headers and streaming chunking pattern? Specifically include `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and `Connection: keep-alive`.
Priya (support): Sent a repro curl from Ava (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"stream this", "stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/hosted/generate
```
Ava (customer): Here's the client-side log: connection reset after ~6s, then retries backoff.
Mike (eng-sre): Two hypotheses: 1) TLS handshakes to upstream were queuing due to worker thread saturation on model nodes during the rollout, causing Envoy to hit upstream idle/timeout -> 502. 2) NLB health check flapping due to brief TLS neighborship mismatch during SNI rotation.
Jonah (infra): I checked NLB metrics — health check failures correlate with the times. We also have occasional certificate rotation events in that window.
Priya (support): Customer wants a mitigation now — they can't tolerate retries.
Mike (eng-sre): Short-term: pin their traffic to the previous stable model backend (route-by-model-version) until rollout completes. Also increase upstream connect timeout in edge to 10s for streaming paths.
Jonah (infra): I'll open a priority change to route config and bump connect timeout for /v1/hosted/generate route.
Priya (support): Noted, told customer we have a mitigation and will update in 10m. :thumbsup:
Mike (eng-sre): Long-term: add graceful cert handoff to NLB and add a small warmup window during model swaps so we don't add new TLS connections to just-booted nodes. Also add a circuit-backoff metric when NLB HC fails.
Ava (customer): Thanks, will confirm if pinning fixes the spike.
Oncall Bot: Change request CR-7731 created by Jonah.
